fixed_at_registration.note: 0.55 in_fold_threshold_mode is NON-OPERATIVE and is never used.

primary_reporting_metrics.name: balanced_accuracy
primary_reporting_metrics.uncertainty: NONE REPORTED. A binomial interval is not valid for a ratio of two proportions on one small sample.

primary_reporting_metrics.name: confusion_matrix
primary_reporting_metrics.definition: full 2x2 over stable scored cases only

human_unstable_handling.reporting: aggregate count only, reported separately from all binary metrics
human_unstable_handling.identity_disclosure: individual unstable item identities are never published, because the held-out unstable identities are derivable by set difference (see FIREWALL_POLICY.json)

small_n_policy.authorized_categories: NONE. strong / partial / failure is NOT authorized.
small_n_policy.required_statement: n is too small for a defensible categorical performance boundary.
small_n_policy.rationale: At n on the order of 18 scored stable cases, the exact 95% interval on a single proportion is wider than the development effect being assessed, so any categorical cut point would be an artifact of the sample size rather than a measurement.

post_reveal_prohibitions: NO relabelling of stable human answers.
NO second attempt on this held-out set.
Any future classifier improvement must be a NEW development cycle. This held-out result remains historical evidence and may not be reused as if it were a fresh evaluation set.
integrity_requirements_on_the_scoring_co: It must compute only the preregistered metric set.
It must be hash-anchored before held-out reveal.
It must reject any prediction artifact carrying a label field.
execution_order_binding: Predictions for all 20 held-out items are generated and hashed BEFORE any human label is opened.
Scoring runs exactly once, after separate PI reveal authorization, using this frozen code.
A second scoring run on the same held-out set is prohibited.
outstanding_pi_decisions: Whether to commit the currently untracked scientific packages before held-out use.
Formal acceptance that no numeric categorical boundary will be reported.
Whether the anchor + external mirror is sufficient, or a Git commit is additionally required.
